## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. If a check was not run, explain why.
For UI changes, add a screenshot using fictional demo data.

## Notes

Mention any compatibility, data-storage or permission changes reviewers should understand.
Do not include real financial data, tokens, OAuth callback URLs, database/key files or private notes.
